news.title: MLB proposes delaying salary cap until 2028 amid start of free agency, labor uncertainty
news.summary: Major League Baseball has proposed delaying the implementation of a salary cap until 2028 while it puts into place other elements of its labor offer for 2027.

news.title: Murphy says he regrets Yankees barb, didn't mean to 'slander' Bombers
news.summary: Brewers manager Pat Murphy says he regrets his recent comments to Jake Bauers about the Yankees, adding that he didn't intend to "slander" the Bronx Bombers.

news.title: Mariners hire Kanzler as manager to replace fired Wilson
news.summary: The Mariners have named Cubs farm director Jason Kanzler as their next manager, the team announced Tuesday.

news.title: Baker, Piniella headline Baseball Hall of Fame contemporary ballot
news.summary: Dusty Baker, Bruce Bochy, Joe Maddon and Lou Piniella are among the retired baseball managers up for Hall of Fame consideration on the contemporary era ballot.

news.title: Bednar, Suzuki, Arozarena among eight players to receive qualifying offers
news.summary: Eight players received $23.15 million qualifying offers from their teams Monday.

news.title: Rangers CF Carter has hip surgery, likely to miss start of season
news.summary: Texas Rangers centerfielder Evan Carter underwent hip surgery to address a labral issue and hip impingement and is unlikely to be ready for the start of next season.
